prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a hit while turning left. The patient had 16 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1146; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck from the side while completing a left turn. Presenting complaints included neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with cervical whiplash-type injury, and the mechanism described is a plausible cause of these symptoms for a collision of this kind. Examination documented restricted cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, and imaging findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. The patient's history includes a small strain to the same region several years ago that resolved completely with no lasting limitation. Care over sixteen visits followed a usual course of manual therapy, supervised exercise, and home program instruction. Symptoms and function improved steadily, and visit frequency was tapered as the patient reached a stable point. Billed services reflect the treatment delivered, with no repeated charges for the same service. At last evaluation the patient reported near-resolution of symptoms and was discharged to a self-directed home exercise program with return precautions provided.
